title: Swara Baby Products IPO Details
intro:
Swara Baby Products IPO is a book-built issue of ₹799.88 crores. The issue is a combination of fresh issue of 4.50 crore shares aggregating to ₹499.88 crores and offer for sale of 2.70 crore shares aggregating to ₹300.00 crores.

Swara Baby Products IPO opens for subscription on Dec 2, 2026 and closes on Dec 4, 2026. The allotment for the Swara Baby Products IPO is expected to be finalized on Dec 7, 2026. Swara Baby Products IPO will list on NSE and BSE with a tentative listing date fixed as Dec 9, 2026.

Swara Baby Products IPO is set issue price band at ₹105 to ₹111 per share. The lot size for an application is 135 shares. The minimum amount of investment required by an individual investor (retail) is ₹14,985 (135 shares) (based on upper price).

JM Financial Ltd. is the book running lead manager and MUFG Intime India Pvt.Ltd. is the registrar of the issue.

Refer to Swara Baby Products IPO RHP for detailed Information.

faqs.question: How to apply in Swara Baby Products IPO through Zerodha?
faqs.answer: Zerodha customers can apply for the Swara Baby Products IPO online through the Kite platform under the IPO & Bids section using UPI as the payment method. Steps to Apply for Swara Baby Products IPO through Zerodha Log in to your Zerodha Kite account. On the home page, click IPO & Bids in the top menu. Select the IPO tab and find the Swara Baby Products IPO in the list. Click Apply next to the IPO. Enter your UPI ID, bid quantity, and bid price. Submit the IPO application. Open your UPI app and approve the mandate to complete the application process. For more details, visit the Zerodha IPO Application Process Review .

faqs.answer: You can apply in Swara Baby Products IPO online using either UPI or ASBA as a payment method. ASBA IPO application is available in the net banking of your bank account.
